name: hra-cell-types
description: Fetch HRA cell-type term occurrences (Cell Ontology) from the CCF API.

load_step.doc: Fetch HRA cell-type term occurrences (Cell Ontology, CURIE-keyed) from the CCF API's `/v1/cell-type-term-occurences` endpoint, sorted by occurrence count descending.

_contract.summary: Fetch HRA cell-type term occurrences (Cell Ontology, CURIE-keyed) from the CCF API's `/v1/cell-type-term-occurences` endpoint, sorted by occurrence count descending.

outputs.cell_types: One `cell_type_term` record per distinct Cell Ontology term: `cl` (CL CURIE) and `count` (occurrences across HRA datasets), sorted by `count` descending.

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
